title: Watch a rule raise an alarm
description: Unplug a simulated touch panel from its page, watch the official reachability rule wait out its sustain and open a High alarm, and see the panel's system go degraded because of it.

steps.caption: Touch Panel 2 fills the Touch Control role of Media Lab Classroom 2. It reads healthy.
The panel is simulated, so it can be broken on purpose from its own page.
Unplug it. The simulated panel goes dark on every protocol, as if its cable were pulled.
Save. The panel is marked unplugged, and the simulator applies it on its next pull.
Rules turn readings into alarms. The official rule fires when an endpoint reads down for 15s.
Open the rule to watch it work. It holds nothing yet.
The panel's endpoint read down. The rule waits out its sustain, so one failed probe never pages.
The down held for the whole sustain, so the rule opened a High alarm on the panel.
The panel's system, Media Lab Classroom 2. Why names the rule's alarm on the panel.
The alarm takes the panel out, so Touch Control is short and the system reads degraded.
